maya.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the edit target and exact felt material/color reference: maya's existing six-part puppet atlas. Output ONLY the corrected shirt TORSO as a single isolated transparent PNG cutout, without the other five pieces. Keep the exact bright coral red shirt fabric color, dense small wool-fiber texture, tiny curved round-neck felt collar, simple flat hand-cut applique aesthetic of the input torso. This is a torso replacement for that exact character, not a costume redesign.
CRITICAL EDIT: completely remove every attached sleeve, sleeve nub, upper-arm bump, arm tucked behind back, and shoulder crease from the body. The silhouette must be a simple symmetric sleeveless torso: short shoulders sloping smoothly down from each side of the small neckline, then smooth gently flaring side edges to a rounded waist hem. No side protrusions, no arm holes, no sewn vertical shoulder seams, no vest borders. The sides should look like the central trunk of a puppet, ready to have two independent movable felt arms placed ON TOP. Broad lower torso, gently narrower upper torso, approximately 0.90 width to 1 height. Collar remains centered at the top. No shoulders rounded into arm shapes.
Straight front view, smooth clean edges, sharp felt fibers, thin flat sheet of felt, no sculpted volume, no knit or woven fabric, no wrinkles. Match the reference's original texture and color, avoid lighting gradients so replacement arms will match. Center one torso in a square canvas with generous 15% transparent padding, full object visible. Genuine transparent background, no cast shadow or floor, no checkerboard pixels, no text, no human body, no head, NO ARMS OR HANDS. Only the torso.
